Title: Absorb Energy
Name: Absorb Energy
Effect: Upon casting this Spell, the Caster chooses one of the following energy types; Acid, Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. The target may Absorb a single effect, which causes the specified damage type, negating it and healing a number of Hit Points equal to the damage absorbed. Any healing above the Character's maximum Hit Point total is lost. The call for the Absorb ability is "Absorb".
Incantation: "I grant you the Protection of Absorb Energy"

Title: Acid Splash
Name: Acid Splash
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to deliver a packet attack causing ten(10) points of Physical Acid damage.
Incantation: "I Conjure an Acid Splash."

Title: Aegis
Name: Aegis
Effect: Upon casting this Spell, the Caster must cross both arms across their chest and can move at no faster than a walking pace. So long as both these requirements are met, the Caster is Immune to all Weapon Damage and <Effect>-Strikes.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of an Aegis."

Title: Alarm
Name: Alarm
Effect: This Spell causes the target room to become magically protected. Any creature within the room at the time of casting gains an investiture into the Alarm. Any creature, who is not invested, that attempts to enter this room must knock loudly for ten(10) seconds upon entering. A room which is the target of this Spell must have a large "A" emblazoned on the back of the Room's Marshal Notes.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of an Alarm."

Title: Alarm, Greater
Name: Alarm, Greater
Effect: This Spell causes the target room to become magically protected. Any creature within the room at the time of casting gains an investiture into the Alarm. Any creature, who is not invested, that attempts to enter this room must knock loudly for ten(10) seconds upon entering. A room which is the target of this Spell must have a large "A" emblazoned on the back of the Room's Marshal Notes. This effect cannot be Dispelled.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Greater Alarm."

Title: Alarm, Superior
Name: Alarm, Superior
Effect: This Spell causes the target Room to become magically protected. Any creature within the room at the time of casting gains an investiture into the Alarm. Any creature, who is not invested, that attempts to enter this room must knock loudly for ten(10) seconds upon entering. A room which is the target of this Spell must have a large "A" emblazoned on the back of the Room's Marshal Notes. Additionally, the intruding creature is affected by a single harmful Spell from the Caster's memory which is cast as part of casting this Spell and below 7 th Level. The chosen spell is delivered as Magic against the intruder. This effect cannot be Dispelled.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Superior Alarm."

Title: Ambush
Name: Ambush
Effect: This Spell grants the target the ability to use any one(1) Skill, which requires the target to be behind the target, regardless of their position.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of an Ambush."

Title: Arcane Shroud
Name: Arcane Shroud
Effect: Upon casting this Spell, the Caster must cross both arms across their chest and can move at no faster than a walking pace. So long as both these requirements are met, the Caster is immune to all Weapon Damage and <Effect>-Strikes. This effect lasts a maximum of ten(10) seconds.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of an Arcane Shroud."

Title: Banish
Name: Banish
Effect: This Spell forces the target Extraplanar creature or Elemental back to its home plane. A creature which has been affected by this effect cannot return to the plane from which it was Banished for twenty-four(24) hours. This Spell only functions on Hymira and will fail if cast on any other Plane.
Incantation: "I Conjure a force to Banish."

Title: Banshee's Cry
Name: Banshee's Cry
Effect: of Effect: Circle <Magic Death>"
Incantation: "I inflict the Banshee's Cry upon you."

Title: Barrier
Name: Barrier
Effect: This Spell grants its Caster ten(10) Fortification Points. These points are always the first lost due to damage. Unless explicitly stated otherwise, Fortification Points from multiple sources do not stack.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Barrier."

Title: Bind [Binding]
Name: Bind
Effect: This Spell forces the target's arms to their sides and keeps them there throughout its duration. The creature cannot use any Skill which requires the use of their arms such as using weapons or casting Spells. This Spell is a Binding effect and removed by Dispel Binding.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force to Bind you."

Title: Binding Shield
Name: Binding Shield
Effect: This Spell negates the next Binding effect by which the target is struck. The following effects are Binding; Bind, Confine, Pin, and Web.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Binding Shield."

Title: Blood Bolt
Name: Blood Bolt
Effect: This Spell can be used for one of two(2) effects. The first causes five(5) points of Piercing Magic Body damage to the target. The second causes five(5) points of Piercing Magic Healing to the target. In either case, the Caster must expend two(2) Hit Points to cast this Spell. If this Spell is affected by the Echo Spellshape effect the caster must expend the Hit Points again for each time the effect is duplicated. If this Spell is affected by the Empower Spellshape effect the caster must instead expend twice the number of Hit Points the Spell normally requires. If this Spell is placed in a Potion or Scroll the Caster must choose which of the two(2) effects are contained within the crafted item.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Blood Bolt."
Delivery Verbal: "5 Piercing Magic Body" or "5 Piercing Magic Healing"

Title: Blood Lance
Name: Blood Lance
Effect: This Spell can be used for one of two(2) effects. The first causes thirty(30) points of Piercing Magic Body damage to the target. The second causes thirty(30) points of Piercing Magic Healing to the target. In either case, the Caster must expend seven(7) Hit Points to cast this Spell. If this Spell is affected by the Echo Spellshape effect the caster must expend the Hit Points again for each time the effect is duplicated. If this Spell is affected by the Empower Spellshape effect the caster must instead expend twice the number of Hit Points the Spell normally requires. If this Spell is placed in a Potion or Scroll, the Caster must choose which of the two(2) effects are contained within the crafted item.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Blood Lance."
Delivery Verbal: "30 Piercing Magic Body" or "30 Piercing Magic Healing"

Title: Blood Wall
Name: Blood Wall
Effect: This Spell can be used for one of two(2) effects. The first causes twenty(20) points of Piercing Magic Body damage to the target. The second causes twenty(20) points of Piercing Magic Healing to the target. In either case, the Caster must expend eight(8) Hit Points to cast this Spell. The Caster may throw any number of packets when using this Spell and any creature struck by one or more packets is affected. If this Spell is affected by the Echo Spellshape effect the caster must expend the Hit Points again for each time the effect is duplicated. If this Spell is affected by the Empower Spellshape effect the caster must instead expend twice the number of Hit Points the Spell normally requires. If this Spell is placed in a Potion or Scroll, the Caster must choose which of the two(2) effects are contained within the crafted item.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Blood Wall."
Delivery Verbal: "20 Piercing Magic Body" or "20 Piercing Magic Healing"

Title: Bone Armour
Name: Bone Armour
Effect: In order to cast this Spell the Caster must have costuming depicting bones on their torso. This Spell grants the Caster five(5) points of Natural Armour. This effect does not stack with any other source of Natural Armour.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of Bone Armour."

Title: Bone Armour, Greater
Name: Bone Armour, Greater
Effect: In order to cast this Spell the Caster must have costuming depicting bones on their torso. This Spell grants the Caster ten(10) points of Natural Armour. This effect does not stack with any other source of Natural Armour.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of Greater Bone Armour."

Title: Bone Armour, Superior
Name: Bone Armour, Superior
Effect: In order to cast this Spell the Caster have costuming depicting bones on their torso. This Spell grants the Caster twenty(20) points of Natural Armour. This effect does not stack with any other source of Natural Armour.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of Superior Bone Armour."

Title: Break
Name: Break
Effect: This Spell Breaks the target item. A Broken item cannot be used until it is Repaired. Certain creatures, such as Constructs, may be damaged by this Spell. If the target has multiple items in their possession which match the description of the item designated by the Caster it is the target who chooses which of their items are affected. The target cannot choose an item which is Indestructible unless it is the only item they have which matches that description.
Incantation: "I alter this form to be Broken."

Title: Calm [Compulsion]
Name: Calm
Effect: This Compulsion Spell causes the target to enter an extremely calm and tranquil state. The target cannot attack themselves or any other creature though they will not ignore danger. This effect ends if the target is attacked.
Incantation: "I Compel you to be Calm."

Title: Charm [Compulsion]
Name: Charm
Effect: This Compulsion Spell causes the target to view the caster as a trusted friend listening to their suggestions and not attacking them. This does not grant the Caster any control over the target. This effect ends if the Caster attacks the target.
Incantation: "I Compel you to be Charmed."

Title: Clarity
Name: Clarity
Effect: This Spell instantly grants the target the benefits of having Meditated. This applies only to expended Skills which are recovered by Meditating.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to grant you Clarity."

Title: Cleanse
Name: Cleanse
Effect: This Spell instantly removes all harmful effects from the target which would be removed by the target's Death as well as Enthral. The target's player makes the determination as to which effects are harmful.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to Cleanse you."

Title: Compulsion Shield
Name: Compulsion Shield
Effect: This Spell negates the next Compulsion effect by which the target is struck. The following effects are Compulsions; Calm, Charm, Dominate, Fear, Shun, Silence, and Sleep. Enthral is not a Compulsion.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Compulsion Shield."

Title: Confine [Binding]
Name: Confine
Effect: This Binding Spell forces the victim's arms to their sides and completely immobilises them, preventing them from moving or using any Skills while under its effects. The target may still speak. This Spell is a Binding effect.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force to Confine you."

Title: Conjure Weapon
Name: Conjure Weapon
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster a weapon formed from magical energy. This weapon is mundane in nature but functions only for the Caster. As such, it must be red or marked by a red band on the handle. This Spell does not grant the Caster Proficiency in the chosen weapon. The Caster may put the weapon away and retrieve it at any time so long as they have at least one free hand.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Weapon."

Title: Consume Life
Name: Consume Life
Effect: This Spell must be cast immediately before a Killing Blow. The Killing Blow must be started within ten(10) seconds of the casting of this Spell. Once the Caster has delivered a successful Killing Blow they recover thirty(30) Hit Points. Any excess healing from this Spell is converted to Fortification Points. Multiple effects which grant Fortification Points do not stack.
Incantation: "I grant you the power to Consume Life"

Title: Control Elemental
Name: Control Elemental
Effect: This Spell places the target mindless Elemental under the Caster's complete control. The target will obey all the Caster's orders including self destructive ones. This Spell removed any previous casting of Control Elemental from the target.
Incantation: "I Compel this Elemental to be Controlled."

Title: Control Undead
Name: Control Undead
Effect: This Spell places the target mindless Undead under the Caster's complete control. The target will obey all the Caster's orders including self destructive ones. This Spell removed any previous casting of Control Undead from the target.
Incantation: "I Compel this Undead to be Controlled."

Title: Corrosion
Name: Corrosion
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to deliver a Break effect by Touch. An item which is Broken cannot be used until it is Repaired.
Incantation: "I alter this form to be Corroded."

Title: Cure Critical Wounds
Name: Cure Critical Wounds
Effect: This Spell causes thirty(30) points of Magic Healing to the target. Any healing above the Character's maximum is lost.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to Cure Critical Wounds."

Title: Cure Light Wounds
Name: Cure Light Wounds
Effect: This Spell causes five(5) points of Magic Healing to the target. Any healing above the Character's maximum is lost.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to Cure Light Wounds."

Title: Cure Mortal Wounds
Name: Cure Mortal Wounds
Effect: This Spell causes forty(40) points of Magic Healing to the target. Any healing above the Character's maximum is lost.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to Cure Mortal Wounds."

Title: Cure Serious Wounds
Name: Cure Serious Wounds
Effect: This Spell causes twenty(20) points of Magic Healing to the target. Any healing above the Character's maximum is lost.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to Cure Serious Wounds."

Title: Cure Wounds
Name: Cure Wounds
Effect: This Spell causes ten(10) points of Magic Healing to the target. Any healing above the Character's maximum is lost.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to Cure Wounds."

Title: Cure Wounds, Mass
Name: Cure Wounds, Mass
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to deliver a Touch effect which causes ten(10) points of Magic Healing to the target. Any healing above the Character's maximum is lost. The Caster may continue to deliver this Touch effect to any number of creatures but this effect ends if the Caster goes ten(10) seconds without affecting a new target. No target may benefit from this effect more than once from a single casting. This Spell also ends if the Caster casts another Spell or suffers any effect which would Disrupt Spell casting including taking damage or entering a state which would prevent them from casting Spells. The Caster cannot run while Concentrating.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to Cure the Wounds of the Masses."

Title: Curse Shield
Name: Curse Shield
Effect: This Spell negates the next Curse effect by which the target is struck. The following effects are Curses; Cripple, Drain, Fetter, Fumble, Frailty, Paralysis, and Weakness.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Curse Shield."

Title: Death
Name: Death
Effect: This Spell instantly kills the target forcing them to immediately enter their Death count.
Incantation: "I inflict Death upon you."

Title: Destroy Elemental
Name: Destroy Elemental
Effect: This Spell instantly Vanquishes most Elementals. A Vanquished creature instantly begins Bleeding Out. Greater Elementals may not be Vanquished but are instead significantly damaged by this Spell.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force to Destroy Elemental."

Title: Disintegrate
Name: Disintegrate
Effect: This Spell Vanquishes the target creature. A Vanquished creature instantly begins Bleeding Out. Some powerful creatures may not be Vanquished but are significantly damaged by this Spell. The Caster must specify the type of creature being targeted by this spell. The valid options are; Abomination, Animal, Construct, Draconian, Elemental, Fae, Humanoid, Hybrid, Insectoid, Plant, Slime, Spirit and Undead.
Incantation: "I alter this form to be Disintegrated."

Title: Dispel Binding
Name: Dispel Binding
Effect: This Spell instantly removes all Binding effects from the target. The following effects are Binding; Bind, Confine, Pin, and Web.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Dispel Binding."

Title: Dispel Compulsions
Name: Dispel Compulsions
Effect: This Spell instantly removes all Compulsions effects from the target. The following effects are Compulsions; Calm, Charm, Dominate, Fear, Shun, Silence, and Sleep. This Spell does not affect Enthral.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Dispel Compulsions."

Title: Dispel Curse
Name: Dispel Curse
Effect: This Spell instantly removes all Curse effects from the target. The following effects are Curses; Cripple, Drain, Fetter, Fumble, Frailty, Paralysis, Weakness.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Dispel Curse."

Title: Dispel Elemental
Name: Dispel Elemental
Effect: This Spell instantly removes all effects which were delivered as Elemental(-Strike) from the target.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Dispel Elemental."

Title: Dispel Magic
Name: Dispel Magic
Effect: This Spell instantly removes all effects which were delivered as Magic(-Strike) from the target.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Dispel Magic."

Title: Dispel Physical
Name: Dispel Physical
Effect: This Spell instantly removes all effects which were delivered as Physical(-Strike) from the target.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Dispel Physical."

Title: Dispel Poison
Name: Dispel Poison
Effect: This Spell instantly removes all effects which were delivered as Poison(-Strike) from the target.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Dispel Poison."

Title: Drain [Curse]
Name: Drain
Effect: This Curse Spell prevents the target from running or using any Skills until the effect ends or is removed.
Incantation: "I Curse you to be Drained."

Title: Elemental Aura
Name: Elemental Aura
Effect: The target of this Spell may, at a time of their choosing, trigger it allowing them to use one of the following damage types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone, for the duration of Combat. Combat is considered to be over when the Character goes one(1) minute without attacking, or being attacked by, an enemy. The chosen damage type is appended to the end of the Character's Weapon Damage call, after the Weapon Type.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of an Elemental Aura."

Title: Elemental Blast
Name: Elemental Blast
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. This Spell causes thirty-five(35) points of Elemental damage of the chosen type.
Incantation: "I Conjure an Elemental Blast."

Title: Elemental Blast, Greater
Name: Elemental Blast, Greater
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. This Spell causes forty(40) points of Elemental damage of the chosen type.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Greater Elemental Blast."

Title: Elemental Blast, Superior
Name: Elemental Blast, Superior
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. This Spell causes fifty(50)points of Elemental damage of the chosen type.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Superior Elemental Blast."

Title: Elemental Bolt
Name: Elemental Bolt
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. This Spell causes five(5) points of Elemental damage of the chosen type.
Incantation: "I Conjure an Elemental Bolt."

Title: Elemental Bolt, Greater
Name: Elemental Bolt, Greater
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. This Spell causes ten(10) points of Elemental damage of the chosen type.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Greater Elemental Bolt."

Title: Elemental Bolt, Superior
Name: Elemental Bolt, Superior
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. This Spell causes fifteen(15) points of Elemental damage of the chosen type.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Superior Elemental Bolt."

Title: Elemental Fury
Name: Elemental Fury
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. The Caster may deliver a packet attack causing one(1) Elemental damage of the chosen type at will. This Spell ends if the Caster Dies or casts any other Spell. The individual packet attacks are subject to Disruption. This Spell cannot benefit from the effects of any Spellshape or ability which modifies the casting of a single Spell.
Incantation: "I Conjure the Fury of the Elements."

Title: Elemental Fury, Greater
Name: Elemental Fury, Greater
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. The Caster may deliver a packet attack causing two(2) Elemental damage of the chosen type at will. This Spell ends if the Caster Dies or casts any other Spell. The individual packet attacks are subject to Disruption. This Spell cannot benefit from the effects of any Spellshape or ability which modifies the casting of a single Spell.
Incantation: "I Conjure the Greater Fury of the Elements."

Title: Elemental Fury, Superior
Name: Elemental Fury, Superior
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. The Caster may deliver a packet attack causing five(5) Elemental damage of the chosen type at will. This Spell ends if the Caster Dies or casts any other Spell. The individual packet attacks are subject to Disruption. This Spell cannot benefit from the effects of any Spellshape or ability which modifies the casting of a single Spell.
Incantation: "I Conjure the Superior Fury of the Elements."

Title: Elemental Lance
Name: Elemental Lance
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. This Spell causes twenty(20) points of Elemental damage of the chosen type.
Incantation: "I Conjure an Elemental Lance."

Title: Elemental Lance, Greater
Name: Elemental Lance, Greater
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. This Spell causes twenty-five(25) points of Elemental damage of the chosen type.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Greater Elemental Lance."

Title: Elemental Lance, Superior
Name: Elemental Lance, Superior
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. This Spell causes thirty(30) points of Elemental damage of the chosen type.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Superior Elemental Lance."

Title: Elemental Ray
Name: Elemental Ray
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. This Spell causes thirty(30) points of Piercing Elemental damage of the chosen type.
Incantation: "I Conjure an Elemental Ray."

Title: Elemental Reduction
Name: Elemental Reduction
Effect: This Spell reduces the damage of the next effect causing Elemental damage, by which they are struck, by half rounded down.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of Elemental Reduction."

Title: Elemental Reflection
Name: Elemental Reflection
Effect: This Spell causes the next effect delivered as Elemental(-Strike) by which the target is struck to be reflected back at the attacker. If the effect is reflected twice it is instead negated.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of Elemental Reflection."

Title: Elemental Shield
Name: Elemental Shield
Effect: This Spell negates the next effect delivered as Elemental(-Strike) by which the target is struck.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of an Elemental Shield."

Title: Elemental Sparks
Name: Elemental Sparks
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. This Spell causes one(1) point of Elemental damage of the chosen type. The Caster may throw any number of packets with one hand, any creature struck by one or more is affected.
Incantation: "I Conjure Elemental Sparks."

Title: Elemental Ward
Name: Elemental Ward
Effect: This Spell grants the target the ability to negate a single effect delivered as Elemental(-Strike) by which the target is struck. The target's Player chooses when this ability activates.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of an Elemental Ward."

Title: Empathic Healing
Name: Empathic Healing
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster the ability to deliver a Touch effect causing one(1) point of Magic Healing to the target. Each time the Character uses this ability they lose one(1) Hit Point. This Spell is not Disrupted by the damage it causes to the Caster.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to grant Empathic Healing."

Title: Energy Orb
Name: Energy Orb
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. The Caster gains five(5) charges of this ability. The Caster may expend a charge from this ability in order to deliver a packet attack causing five(5) points of Magic damage of the chosen type.
Incantation: "I Conjure an Energy Orb"

Title: Energy Shield
Name: Energy Shield
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. The target gains a Shield against the next effect by which they are struck which causes the chosen type.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of an Energy Shield."

Title: Energy Sphere
Name: Energy Sphere
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. The Caster gains five(5) charges of this ability. The Caster may expend a charge from this ability in order to deliver a packet attack causing ten(10) Magic damage of the chosen type.
Incantation: "I Conjure an Energy Sphere"

Title: Enhance Armour
Name: Enhance Armour
Effect: This Spell increases the Armour Point total of the target suit of Physical Armour by five(5) for its duration. This effect does not stack with any other effect which Enhances Physical Armour.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of Enhanced Armour."

Title: Fabricate
Name: Fabricate
Effect: This Spell can create any mundane item such as a weapon or suit of armour. It cannot be used to create an item with any special properties such as a silvered weapon or enhanced armour. The player must provide the physical representation of any item created by this Spell. This Spell cannot be used to create any item of value such as gold, silver, gems or other precious materials. Nor can it be used to create items with supernatural qualities such as Ritual Components. Any attempt to create such items results in worthless duplicates such as brazen coins, coloured glass or materials of poor quality.
Incantation: "I alter this form to be Fabricated."

Title: False Vitality
Name: False Vitality
Effect: This Spell appears to return a Dead creature to life, however it only lasts five(5) minutes, after which the target will again die, restarting their Death count. This effect returns the target to life at one(1) Hit Point. While under the effects of this Spell the target is Conscious and able to act and use Skills normally. If this effect is Removed or Dispelled the target immediately restarts their Death Count. A Life effect received by the target before this effect ends removes it without causing the target to die.
Incantation: "I Curse you with False Vitality."

Title: Fear [Compulsion]
Name: Fear
Effect: This Compulsion Spell causes the target to immediately flee the Caster's presence attempting to break line of sight with them. They cannot use any Skills while under this effect. Once the target has broken line of sight with the Caster for ten(10) seconds they may again use their Skills but this effect remains active unless it ends or is Removed. Until it does, if the target returns to the Caster's line of sight they again lose access to all Skills and must flee in an attempt to once again break line of sight.
Incantation: "I Compel you to Fear me."

Title: Feast of Flesh
Name: Feast of Flesh
Effect: This Spell must be cast immediately before a Killing Blow. The Killing Blow must be started within ten(10) seconds of the casting of this Spell. Once the Caster has delivered a successful Killing Blow they recover fifty(50) Hit Points. Any excess healing from this Spell is converted to Fortification Points up to a maximum of twenty(20). Multiple effects which grant Fortification Points do not stack.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of a Feast of Flesh"

Title: Fetter [Curse]
Name: Fetter
Effect: This Curse Spell prevents the target from running or jumping. The target must have at least one foot on the ground at all times and cannot move faster than a normal walking pace.
Incantation: "I Curse you to be Fettered."

Title: Fireball
Name: Fireball
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to throw any number of packets causing ten(10) points of Magic Fire damage to any creature struck by one or more packets.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Fireball."

Title: Flay [Curse]
Name: Flay
Effect: This Curse Spell instantly reduces the value of any Natural Armour worn by the target to zero(0).
Incantation: "I Curse you to be Flayed."

Title: Force Bolt
Name: Force Bolt
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to deliver a packet attack causing fifteen(15) points of Magic Force damage.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force Bolt"

Title: Force Dart
Name: Force Dart
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to deliver a packet attack causing five(5) points of Magic Force damage.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force Dart"

Title: Force Lance
Name: Force Lance
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to deliver a packet attack causing thirty(30) points of Magic Force damage.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force Lance"

Title: Force Storm
Name: Force Storm
Effect: One this Spell is cast, the Caster may deliver a packet attack, causing ten(10) points of Magic Force damage, at will. This Spell ends if the Caster casts another Spell or suffers any effect which would Disrupt Spell casting including taking damage or entering a state which would prevent them from casting Spells. The Caster cannot run while Concentrating.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force Storm"

Title: Force Wave
Name: Force Wave
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to throw any number of packets causing ten(10) points of Magic Force damage to any creature struck by one or more packets.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force Wave"

Title: Fortify
Name: Fortify
Effect: This Spell grants the target five(5) Fortification Points. These Fortification Points are always the first lost due to damage. Multiple effects which grant Fortification Points do not stack.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of Fortification."

Title: Fortify, Greater
Name: Fortify, Greater
Effect: This Spell grants the target ten(10) Fortification Points. These Fortification Points are always the first lost due to damage. Multiple effects which grant Fortification Points do not stack.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of Greater Fortification."

Title: Fortify, Superior
Name: Fortify, Superior
Effect: This Spell grants the target twenty(20) Fortification Points. These Fortification Points are always the first lost due to damage. Multiple effects which grant Fortification Points do not stack.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of Superior Fortification."

Title: Fortify, Mass
Name: Fortify, Mass
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to deliver a Touch effect which grants five(5) Fortification Points to any target. The Caster may continue to deliver this Touch effect to any number of creatures but this effect ends if the Caster goes ten(10) seconds without affecting a new target. No target may benefit from this effect more than once from a single casting. This Spell also ends if the Caster casts another Spell or suffers any effect which would Disrupt Spell casting including taking damage or entering a state which would prevent them from casting Spells. The Caster cannot run while Concentrating.
Incantation: "I grant the Masses the protection of Fortification."

Title: Frailty [Curse]
Name: Frailty
Effect: This Curse Spell causes the target to take double damage from all sources. Additionally, the Character cannot use any form of the Defensive Ability Resist <Effect> or <Effect> Resistance.
Incantation: "I Curse you with Frailty."

Title: Frighten [Compulsion]
Name: Frighten
Effect: This Compulsion Spell causes the target to immediately flee the Caster's presence attempting to break line of sight with them. They cannot use any Skills while under this effect. This Spell lasts ten(10) seconds.
Incantation: "I Compel you to be Frightened."

Title: Fumble [Curse]
Name: Fumble
Effect: This Curse Spell prevents the target from using a single weapon chosen by the Caster, or using any Skill requiring the use of the weapon for its duration. If the target is wielding more than one weapon which matches the description named by the Caster it us up to the target which weapon is affected.
Incantation: "I Curse you with Fumble."

Title: Harden Flesh
Name: Harden Flesh
Effect: This Spell grants the target ten(10) points of Natural Armour. This effect does not stack with Natural Armour from any other source. A Character under the effects of this Spell cannot benefit from any other type of Armour preventing them from also benefiting from Arcane Armour, Avoidance Armour, Physical Armour, or any other source of Natural Armour.
Incantation: "I alter this form to grant it Hardened Flesh."

Title: Harden Flesh, Greater
Name: Harden Flesh, Greater
Effect: This Spell grants the target twenty(20) points of Natural Armour. This effect does not stack with Natural Armour from any other source. A Character under the effects of this Spell cannot benefit from any other type of Armour preventing them from also benefiting from Arcane Armour, Avoidance Armour, Physical Armour, or any other source of Natural Armour.
Incantation: "I alter this form to grant it Greater Hardened Flesh."

Title: Harvest Life
Name: Harvest Life
Effect: This Spell must be cast immediately before a Killing Blow. The Killing Blow must be started within ten(10) seconds of the casting of this Spell. Once the Caster has delivered a successful Killing Blow they recover ten(10) Hit Points. Any excess healing from this Spell is converted to Fortification Points. Multiple effects which grant Fortification Points do not stack.
Incantation: "I grant you the power to Harvest Life"

Title: Haste
Name: Haste
Effect: This Spell instantly Refits any Avoidance Armour possessed by the target to its full value.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of Haste."

Title: Healing Nova
Name: Healing Nova
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to throw any number of packets. Any creature struck by one or more packets takes twenty(20) points of Magic Healing.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to create a Healing Nova."

Title: Healing Orb
Name: Healing Orb
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster three(3) Charges. The Caster may expend one(1) charge to deliver a packet attack causing ten(10) points of Magic Healing.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to create a Healing Orb."

Title: Healing Rain
Name: Healing Rain
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to throw any number of packets. Any creature struck by one or more packets takes two(2) points of Magic Healing.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to create a Healing Rain."

Title: Healing Touch
Name: Healing Touch
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster the ability to deliver, by Touch, one(1) point of Magic Healing. This ability can be used ten(10) times before the Character must Meditate to regain the ten(10) expended Charges. This Spell ends if the Caster casts any other Spell or enters a state where they are unable to cast Spells. This Spell cannot benefit from the effects of any Spellshape or ability which modifies the casting of a single Spell.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to grant me Healing Touch."

Title: Healing Touch, Greater
Name: Healing Touch, Greater
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster the ability to deliver, by Touch, two(2) points of Magic Healing. This ability can be used ten(10) times before the Character must Meditate to regain the ten(10) expended Charges. This Spell ends if the Caster casts any other Spell or enters a state where they are unable to cast Spells. This Spell cannot benefit from the effects of any Spellshape or ability which modifies the casting of a single Spell.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to grant me Greater Healing Touch."

Title: Healing Touch, Superior
Name: Healing Touch, Superior
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster the ability to deliver, by Touch, four(4) points of Magic Healing. This ability can be used ten(10) times before the Character must Meditate to regain the ten(10) expended Charges. This Spell ends if the Caster casts any other Spell or enters a state where they are unable to cast Spells. This Spell cannot benefit from the effects of any Spellshape or ability which modifies the casting of a single Spell.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to grant me Superior Healing Touch."

Title: Healing Wave
Name: Healing Wave
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to throw any number of packets. Any creature struck by one or more packets takes ten(10) points of Magic Healing.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to create a Healing Wave."

Title: Hush [Compulsion]
Name: Hush
Effect: This Compulsion Spell prevents the target from speaking or casting Spells with an Incantation. Additionally, the target cannot intentionally create any sound such as clapping or using a noise making tool.
Incantation: "I Compel you to be Hushed."

Title: Icicle
Name: Icicle
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to throw a packet attack causing twenty(20) points of Piercing Magic Ice damage.
Incantation: "I Conjure an Icicle."

Title: Imprison
Name: Imprison
Effect: This Spell encases the target in a magical field preventing them from speaking, moving, being moved, or using any Skills. While inside the Imprison, the target is immune to all effects. This effect can be removed by a Dispel Magic effect. The Caster may also end the Imprison effect by simply touching the target and stating "Imprison down". If the Caster is also the target they may expend one use of the Skill Harden Magic to negate a single Dispel Magic effect from removing the Imprison. The Caster can also use the Imprison to deliver a Killing Blow, which counts as Magic, upon the target. To do so the Caster must touch the target and state "Killing Blow 1, Killing Blow 2, Killing Blow 3, Magic"
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force to Imprison you."

Title: Inflict Critical Wounds
Name: Inflict Critical Wounds
Effect: This Spell causes thirty(30) points of Magic Body damage to the target.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Inflict Critical Wounds."

Title: Inflict Critical Wounds, Mass
Name: Inflict Critical Wounds, Mass
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to throw any number of packets. Any target struck by one or more packets takes thirty(30) points of Magic Body damage.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Inflict Critical Wounds upon the Masses."

Title: Inflict Mortal Wounds
Name: Inflict Mortal Wounds
Effect: This Spell causes forty(40) points of Magic Body damage to the target.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Inflict Mortal Wounds."

Title: Inflict Light Wounds
Name: Inflict Light Wounds
Effect: This Spell causes five(5) points of Magic Body damage to the target.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Inflict Light Wounds."

Title: Inflict Serious Wounds
Name: Inflict Serious Wounds
Effect: This Spell causes twenty(20) points of Magic Body damage to the target.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Inflict Serious Wounds."

Title: Inflict Serious Wounds, Mass
Name: Inflict Serious Wounds, Mass
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to throw any number of packets. Any target struck by one or more packets takes twenty(20) points of Magic Body damage.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Inflict Serious Wounds upon the Masses."

Title: Inflict Wounds
Name: Inflict Wounds
Effect: This Spell causes ten(10) points of Magic Body damage to the target.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Inflict Wounds."

Title: Inflict Wounds, Mass
Name: Inflict Wounds, Mass
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to throw any number of packets. Any target struck by one or more packets takes ten(10) points of Magic Body damage.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Inflict Wounds upon the Masses."

Title: Infliction Shield
Name: Infliction Shield
Effect: This Spell negates the next effect which causes <Delivery Type> Body damage.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of an Infliction Shield."

Title: Inspiration
Name: Inspiration
Effect: This Spell allows the target to instantly recover a single expended Skill Slot. A target can benefit from this effect no more than once per Reset regardless of its source.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to Inspire you."

Title: Iron Blade
Name: Iron Blade
Effect: This Spell allows the target to use the Weapon Type: Iron against a single target until the end of Combat.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of an Iron Blade."

Title: Life
Name: Life
Effect: This Spell instantly restores the Dead target to life. The creature is no longer dead and is healed to one(1) Hit Point. If this Spell is cast upon a creature that is not Dead it has no effect but may be recovered by the Caster by Meditating.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to grant you Life."

Title: Light
Name: Light
Effect: This Spell creates a magical light source which allows the use of a diffused flash light, lantern, glow stick or similar light source. A light source may be disqualified from use if it is too bright. The decision as to whether or not a light can be used is up to the Marshal.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of a Light."

Title: Lightning Bolt
Name: Lightning Bolt
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to throw a packet attack causing ten(10) points of Piercing Magic Lightning damage.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Lightning Bolt."

Title: Mage Armour
Name: Mage Armour
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster five(5) points of Arcane Armour. This does not stack with Arcane Armour from any other source. A Character with Arcane Armour must wear one Runes for every ten(10) points of Arcane Armour, or portion thereof, a Character has.
Incantation: "I grant you the Protection of Mage Armour."

Title: Mage Armour, Greater
Name: Mage Armour, Greater
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster ten(10) points of Arcane Armour. This does not stack with Arcane Armour from any other source. A Character with Arcane Armour must wear one Runes for every ten(10) points of Arcane Armour, or portion thereof, a Character has.
Incantation: "I grant you the Protection of Greater Mage Armour."

Title: Mage Armour, Superior
Name: Mage Armour, Superior
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster twenty(20) points of Arcane Armour. This does not stack with Arcane Armour from any other source. A Character with Arcane Armour must wear one Runes for every ten(10) points of Arcane Armour, or portion thereof, a Character has.
Incantation: "I grant you the Protection of Superior Mage Armour."

Title: Magic Shield
Name: Magic Shield
Effect: This Spell grants the target a Shield against the next effect delivered as Magic(-Strike) by which they are struck.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Magic Shield."

Title: Magic Shield, Greater
Name: Magic Shield, Greater
Effect: This Spell grants the target a Shield against the next two(2) effects delivered as Magic(-Strike) by which they are struck.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Greater Magic Shield."

Title: Magic Shield, Mass
Name: Magic Shield, Mass
Effect: Once this Spell is cast the Caster may deliver, by Touch, a "Magic Magic Shield" effect. This effect grants the target a Shield against the next effect delivered as Magic(-Strike) by which they are struck. The Caster may continue to deliver this effect until they go ten(10) seconds without affecting a new target or the Spell is Disrupted. No target can benefit from this effect more than once.
Incantation: "I grant the Masses the protection of a Magic Shield."

Title: Magic Ward
Name: Magic Ward
Effect: This Spell grants the target a Ward allowing them to negate a single effect delivered as Magic(- Strike) by which they are struck. The target chooses when to activate this ability.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Magic Ward."

Title: Might
Name: Might
Effect: This Spell grants the target one(1) point of Strength increasing their Weapon Damage by one(1). This effect does not stack with Strength from any other source.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of Might."

Title: Mirror Image
Name: Mirror Image
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster a Dodge against the next effect, delivered by Weapon or Packet, by which it is struck. Unlike the Dodge Skill, the Caster does not choose when this ability activates, it is automatically triggered as soon as the Caster is struck by an applicable effect.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of a Mirror Image."

Title: Mirror Image, Greater
Name: Mirror Image, Greater
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster a Dodge against the next two(2) effects, delivered by Weapon or Packet, by which it is struck. Unlike the Dodge Skill, the Caster does not choose when this ability activates, it is automatically triggered as soon as the Caster is struck by an applicable effect.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of a Greater Mirror Image."

Title: Mirror Image, Superior
Name: Mirror Image, Superior
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster a Dodge against the next three(3) effects, delivered by Weapon or Packet, by which it is struck. Unlike the Dodge Skill, the Caster does not choose when this ability activates, it is automatically triggered as soon as the Caster is struck by an applicable effect.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of a Superior Mirror Image."

Title: Paralysis [Curse]
Name: Paralysis
Effect: This Curse Spell completely immobilises the target preventing them from speaking, moving or using any Skills while it is in effect. This effect does not prevent the target from being moved.
Incantation: "I Curse you with Paralysis."

Title: Physical Reduction
Name: Physical Reduction
Effect: This Spell grants the target Physical Resistance, reducing the damage from the next effect delivered as Physical(-Strike), which strikes the target, by half rounded down. If the effect is non- damaging its duration is reduced to ten(10) seconds. This effect does not protect against effects delivered as Piercing.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of Physical Reduction."

Title: Physical Shield
Name: Physical Shield
Effect: This Spell grants the target a Shield against the next effect delivered as Physical(-Strike) by which they are struck.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Physical Shield."

Title: Physical Shield, Mass
Name: Physical Shield, Mass
Effect: Once this Spell is cast the Caster may deliver, by Touch, a "Magic Physical Shield" effect. This effect grants the target a Shield against the next effect delivered as Physical(-Strike) by which they are struck. The Caster may continue to deliver this effect until they go ten(10) seconds without affecting a new target or the Spell is Disrupted. No target can benefit from this effect more than once.
Incantation: "I grant the Masses the protection of a Physical Shield."

Title: Physical Ward
Name: Physical Ward
Effect: This Spell grants the target a Ward allowing them to negate a single effect delivered as Physical(- Strike) by which they are struck. The target chooses when to activate this ability.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Physical Ward."

Title: Pin [Binding]
Name: Pin
Effect: This Binding Spell prevents the target from moving, or lifting, their right foot from its position at the time they are affected by this effect. The target may pivot on this foot but can neither lift, nor move it.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force to Pin you."

Title: Poison Shield
Name: Poison Shield
Effect: This Spell grants the target a Shield against the next effect delivered as Poison(-Strike) by which they are struck.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Poison Shield."

Title: Poison Shield, Greater
Name: Poison Shield, Greater
Effect: This Spell grants the target a Shield against the next two(2) effects delivered as Poison(-Strike) by which they are struck.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Greater Poison Shield."

Title: Poison Ward
Name: Poison Ward
Effect: This Spell grants the target a Ward allowing them to negate a single effect delivered as Poison(- Strike) by which they are struck. The target chooses when to activate this ability.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of a Poison Ward."

Title: Predation
Name: Predation
Effect: This Spell grants the target two(2) points of Cunning, increasing their Weapon Damage, when behind their target by two(2). The Cunning from this effect does not stack with any other source.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of Predation."

Title: Predation, Greater
Name: Predation, Greater
Effect: This Spell grants the target four(4) points of Cunning, increasing their Weapon Damage, when behind their target by four(4). The Cunning from this effect does not stack with any other source.
Incantation: "I alter this form to grant it Greater Predation."

Title: Purge Poison
Name: Purge Poison
Effect: Once this Spell is cast the Caster may deliver, at will, by Touch, a "Magic Remove Poison" effect removing a single effect, delivered as Poison(-Strike) from the target. This effect ends if the Caster goes ten(10) seconds without affecting a new target. This Spell also ends if the Caster casts another Spell or suffers any effect which would Disrupt Spell casting including taking damage or entering a state which would prevent them from casting Spells. The Caster cannot run while Concentrating.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Purge Poison."

Title: Refit Any Armour
Name: Refit Any Armour
Effect: This Spell instantly restores all Armour Points, regardless of type, the target possesses, to its full value.
Incantation: "I alter this form to Refit Any Armour."

Title: Refit Arcane Armour
Name: Refit Arcane Armour
Effect: This Spell instantly restores any Arcane Armour the target possesses to its full value.
Incantation: "I alter this form to Refit Arcane Armour."

Title: Refit Natural Armour
Name: Refit Natural Armour
Effect: This Spell instantly restores any Natural Armour the target possesses to its full value.
Incantation: "I alter this form to Refit Natural Armour."

Title: Refit Physical Armour
Name: Refit Physical Armour
Effect: This Spell instantly restores any Physical Armour the target possesses to its full value.
Incantation: "I alter this form to Refit Physical Armour."

Title: Reflect Curse
Name: Reflect Curse
Effect: This Spell causes the next Curse effect, by which the target is struck, to rebound against its source. The call for this effect, when triggered, is "Reflect".
Incantation: "I grant you the Protection of a Reflect Curse."

Title: Reflect Magic
Name: Reflect Magic
Effect: This Spell causes the next effect, delivered as Magic(-Strike), by which the target is struck, to rebound against its source. The call for this effect, when triggered, is "Reflect".
Incantation: "I grant you the Protection of a Reflect Magic."

Title: Regenerate
Name: Regenerate
Effect: This Spell causes the target to begin Regenerating. Upon being affected by this Spell the target may immediately spend a sixty(60)-count to benefit from this effect. At the end of this count the target is restored to maximum Hit Points. When cast on a target that is Dying, the Character's Dying Count is paused for its duration. This effect ends, without effect, if the target is affected by any damaging effect, uses any Skill, or moves faster than a normal walking pace.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to Regenerate you."

Title: Rejuvenate
Name: Rejuvenate
Effect: This Spell causes the target to begin Rejuvenating. Upon being affected by this Spell the target may immediately spend a sixty(60)-count to benefit from this effect. At the end of this count the target is healed of all harmful effects except those that persist through the target's Death. It is up to the target's Player to determine which effects are harmful. This effect ends, without effect, if the target is affected by any damaging effect, uses any Skill, or moves faster than a normal walking pace.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to Rejuvenate you."

Title: Remove Curse
Name: Remove Curse
Effect: This Spell removes, from the target, a single Curse effect. If the target is suffering from multiple Curse effects, it is up to the target to choose which is removed.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Remove Curse."

Title: Remove Drain
Name: Remove Drain
Effect: This Spell removes, from the target, the Drain effect. Since a target cannot have multiple instances of the same effect, this removes all Drains from the target.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Remove Drain."

Title: Remove Drain, Mass
Name: Remove Drain, Mass
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster the ability to deliver, by Touch, a "Magic Remove Drain" effect at will. This effect removes, from the target, a single Drain effect. The Caster may continue to deliver this effect until they go ten(10) seconds without affecting a new target or the Spell is Disrupted. No target can benefit from this effect more than once.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Remove the Drains of the Masses."

Title: Remove Fetter
Name: Remove Fetter
Effect: This Spell removes the Fetter effect from the target. Since a target cannot have multiple instances of the same effect, this removes all Fetter from the target.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Remove Fetter."

Title: Remove Poison
Name: Remove Poison
Effect: This Spell removes, from the target, a single effect which was delivered as Poison(-Strike). If the target is under multiple Poison effects, the target chooses which is removed.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to Remove Poison."

Title: Repair
Name: Repair
Effect: This Spell instantly Repairs a single item touched, and named, by the Caster.
Incantation: "I alter this form to be Repaired."

Title: Repel
Name: Repel
Effect: This Spell forces the target to take ten(10) steps away from the Caster and prevents them from approaching for its duration.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force to repel you."

Title: Restore Limbs
Name: Restore Limbs
Effect: This Spell removes all Cripple effects from the target regardless of Delivery Type.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to Restore your Limbs."

Title: Reverse Damage
Name: Reverse Damage
Effect: This Spell causes ten(10) points of Physical Healing to the target.
Incantation: "I alter this form to Reverse Damage."

Title: Reverse Damage, Greater
Name: Reverse Damage, Greater
Effect: This Spell causes twenty-five(25) points of Physical Healing to the target.
Incantation: "I alter this form to Reverse Greater Damage."

Title: Reverse Damage, Superior
Name: Reverse Damage, Superior
Effect: This Spell causes forty(40) points of Physical Healing to the target.
Incantation: "I alter this form to Reverse Superior Damage."

Title: Rockfall
Name: Rockfall
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to throw any number of packets. Any target struck by one or more packets takes twenty(20) points of Physical Stone damage.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Rockfall."

Title: Safeguard
Name: Safeguard
Effect: This Spell magically seals the target Container preventing any creature from accessing the affected Container. Creatures which were touching the Container at the time of casting may add or remove items from inside the Safeguard. This Spell cannot be Dispelled. Characters can never be stored inside of a Safeguard. The Container targeted by this ability must be marked with an "S". If this Spell is cast upon a container within a Sanctuary, the Caster may choose to cause the target container to become unmovable. This Spell must be included in the Marshal Notes for the Room. Examples of valid containers for this effect are; pouches, bags, chests, bottles, jars and even pockets which have covers. Invalid targets are bowls, cups or pockets which do not have a top.
Incantation: "I grant you the Protection of a Safeguard."

Title: Sanctuary
Name: Sanctuary
Effect: This Spell requires the Caster to touch a portal into the targeted room and perform a special five(5) minute ceremony in order for the Spell to have any effect. Once this Spell takes effect it magically seals the target Room preventing any creature from entering the affected area. Creatures which were inside at the time of casting may enter or exit the Sanctuary room at will, and can even "Recognize" others into the area. The Caster may spend five(5) minutes to grant one or more new Creatures the ability to pass in and out of the effect as if they were present at the time of casting. Neither weapon, nor packet attacks, can pass through the Sanctuary and those inside are not affected by any effect originating from outside the Sanctuary. This Spell cannot be Dispelled. The Room targeted by this ability must be marked with an "S" at all doorways into the room. This Spell must be included in the Marshal Notes for the Room.
Incantation: "I grant you the Protection of a Sanctuary."

Title: Sap [Curse]
Name: Sap
Effect: This Curse Spell prevents the target from running or using any Skills until the effect ends or is removed.
Incantation: "I Curse you to be Sapped."

Title: Seal Container
Name: Seal Container
Effect: This Spell prevents the target container from being opened by anyone but the Caster. Once the Caster opens the target container this effect ends. The Container targeted by this ability must be marked with an "S".
Incantation: "I grant you the Protection of a Sealed Container."

Title: Seal Portal
Name: Seal Portal
Effect: This Spell prevents the target door or window from being opened by anyone but the Caster. Once the Caster opens the target portal this effect ends. The portal targeted by this ability must be marked with an "S".
Incantation: "I grant you the Protection of a Sealed Portal."

Title: Shackle [Binding]
Name: Shackle
Effect: This Binding Spell prevents the target from moving their right foot from its position at the time they are affected by this effect. The target may pivot on this foot but can neither lift, nor move it.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force to Shackle you."

Title: Shadow Snare [Binding]
Name: Shadow Snare
Effect: This Binding Spell prevents the target from moving their right foot from its position at the time they are affected by this effect. The target may pivot on this foot but can neither lift, nor move it.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Shadow Snare."

Title: Shatter Object
Name: Shatter Object
Effect: This Spell Destroys the target item. A Destroyed item cannot be Repaired. Certain creatures, such as Constructs, may be damaged by this Spell. If the target has multiple items in their possession which match the description of the item designated by the Caster it is the target who chooses which of their items are affected. The target cannot choose an item which is Indestructible unless it is the only item they have which matches that description.
Incantation: "I alter this form to be Shattered."

Title: Shatter Storm
Name: Shatter Storm
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster must plant both feet and choose a single item. This Spell allows the Caster to deliver, by packet, a "Magic Break <Item>" effect at will. The Caster may continue to throw packets for this effect until they go ten(10) seconds without delivering this effect, move from their planted location, or use any Skill. A Broken item cannot be used until it is Repaired. Certain creatures, such as Constructs, may be damaged by this Spell. If the target has multiple items in their possession which match the description of the item designated by the Caster it is the target who chooses which of their items are affected. The target cannot choose an item which is Indestructible unless it is the only item they have which matches that description.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dusk to create a Shatter Storm."

Title: Shield Surge
Name: Shield Surge
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster a Shield against the next effect delivered by which they are struck. This Shield is lost after ten(10) seconds.
Incantation: None

Title: Shun [Compulsion]
Name: Shun
Effect: This Compulsion Spell prevents the target from willingly approaching the Caster or attacking the Caster. This effect ends if the Caster attacks the target.
Incantation: "I Compel you to Shun me."

Title: Silence [Compulsion]
Name: Silence
Effect: This Compulsion Spell prevents the target from speaking or casting Spells with an Incantation. Additionally, the target cannot intentionally create any sound such as clapping or using a noise making tool.
Incantation: "I Compel you to Silence."

Title: Silver Blade
Name: Silver Blade
Effect: This Spell allows the target to use the Weapon Type: Silver against a single target until the end of combat.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of a Silver Blade."

Title: Silverstrike
Name: Silverstrike
Effect: This Spell causes thirty(30) points of Physical Silver damage to the target. Additionally, the Caster may use the Weapon Type: Silver against a single target until the end of combat.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Silverstrike."

Title: Sleep [Compulsion]
Name: Sleep
Effect: This Compulsion Spell causes the target to enter into a magical sleep preventing them from moving or using any Skills. The target will lie down wherever they are as soon as it is safe to do so. The target is not aware of their surroundings and is not considered Conscious. This Spell is removed by any effect which removes Compulsion or Poisons.
Incantation: "I Compel you to Sleep."

Title: Slow
Name: Slow
Effect: This Spell reduces the value of any Avoidance Armour worn by the target to zero(0).
Incantation: "I alter this form to be Slowed."

Title: Stabilise
Name: Stabilise
Effect: This Spell instantly Stabilises a Dying creature putting them up to zero(0) Hit Points. This Spell has no effect on a creature that is not Dying.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to Stabilise you."

Title: Stasis
Name: Stasis
Effect: This Spell places the target in a magical stasis. While this Spell is in effect, all effects with a duration, as well any counted actions including, but not limited to, Regeneration, Dying Count, and Meditation are stopped. This Spell cannot be Removed or Dispelled. Only the Caster can end this effect by touching the target and stating "Stasis Down". While under this effect the target is unaware of their surroundings, unable to speak, immune to all effects and they cannot use any Skills or move being utterly immobilised.
Incantation: "I grant you the protection of Stasis."

Title: Status
Name: Status
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to use the Diagnose Skill on the target. This effect ends as soon as the Caster goes ten(10) seconds without asking a new question or performs any action, or suffers any effect, which would Disrupt Spell Casting.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to reveal your Status."

Title: Tarry
Name: Tarry
Effect: This Spell adds five(5) minutes to the target's Death Count up to a maximum of ten(10) minutes.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to grant you Tarrying."

Title: Teleport
Name: Teleport
Effect: This Spell allows the Caster to either return to "Town", a designated Circle of their choosing, or to the last location the Character cast this Spell. The Caster may take any item or items they can carry, but cannot take any other creature. This Spell does not allow the Caster to travel between Planes. Upon casting this Spell, the Caster goes Out-of-Game and walks to the target destination. Immediately, upon arrival, the Player repeats the Delivery Verbal and goes In-Game. This is not a counted action. The Event Staff may designate a specific boundary as the location of "Town".
Incantation: : "I alter this form to be Teleported."

Title: Twist Flesh
Name: Twist Flesh
Effect: This Spell causes ten(10) points of Physical Body damage to the target.
Incantation: "I alter this form to Twist Flesh."

Title: Undead Fortitude
Name: Undead Fortitude
Effect: This Spell grants the target five(5) Fortification Points. This Spell requires the target to openly wear one or more humanoid bones as part of their costuming.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of Undead Fortitude."

Title: Undead Strength
Name: Undead Strength
Effect: This Spell grants the target one(1) point of Strength increasing their Weapon Damage by one(1). This effect does not stack with Strength from any other source. This Spell requires the target to openly wear one or more humanoid bones as part of their costuming.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of Undead Strength."

Title: Verdant Strength
Name: Verdant Strength
Effect: This Spell grants the target one(1) point of Strength increasing their Weapon Damage by one(1). This effect does not stack with Strength from any other source. This Spell requires the target to openly wear leaves, wooden armour or some other plant based component as part of their costuming.
Incantation: "I call upon the Dawn to grant you Strength."

Title: Vorpal Blade
Name: Vorpal Blade
Effect: This Spell grants the target the ability to cause five(5) additional points of damage with their next weapon attack. The target can continue calling this bonus damage until they successfully land a valid strike on their target.
Incantation: "I grant you the power of a Vorpal Blade."

Title: Ward Surge
Name: Ward Surge
Effect: This Spell grants the Caster a Ward against the next effect by which they are struck. This Ward is lost after ten(10) seconds.
Incantation: None

Title: Weakness [Curse]
Name: Weakness
Effect: This Curse Spell prevents the target from using Martial Arts with a Range of Strike, and Skills requiring the use of weapons, except Weapon Proficiencies. The target may still cast Spells which are delivered as <Delivery Type>-Strike.
Incantation: "I Curse you with Weakness."

Title: Web [Binding]
Name: Web
Effect: This Binding Spell forces the victim's arms to their sides and renders them unable to move or be moved. This also prevents the target from using any Skills, requiring the use of their hands or arms, while under its effects. The target may still speak.
Incantation: "I Conjure a Force to Web you."

Title: Wither [Curse]
Name: Wither
Effect: This Curse Spell delivers a Magic Cripple effect affecting the limb of the Caster's choice. A Crippled arm cannot be used for any Skills and cannot hold any items. A Crippled leg cannot be used to walk and prevents the target from moving faster than a slow, limping walking pace. The target cannot hop. If both legs are Crippled the target can only kneel in place.
Incantation: "I Curse you with Withering."

Title: Energy Darts
Name: Energy Darts
Effect: This Cantrip grants the Caster five(5) charges of this effect. The Caster may expend one charge to deliver a packet attack causing two(2) points of Elemental Damage of any of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. As a Cantrip, this effect can be used once, afterwards the Character must Rest in order to regain its use.
Incantation: None

Title: Fortress of Self
Name: Fortress of Self
Effect: This Cantrip grants the Caster five(5) Fortification Points. As a Cantrip, this effect can be used once, afterwards the Character must Rest in order to regain its use.
Incantation: None

Title: Healer's Touch
Name: Healer's Touch
Effect: This Cantrip grants the Caster five(5) charges of this effect. The Caster may expend one charge to deliver, by Touch, one(1) point of Magic Healing. As a Cantrip, this effect can be used once, afterwards the Character must Rest in order to regain its use.
Incantation: None

Title: Spell Conversion
Name: Spell Conversion
Effect: This Cantrip allows the Caster to expend a single Spell Slot in order to regain a single Spell Slot of any level lower than the one expended for this Cantrip. As a Cantrip, this effect can be used once, afterwards the Character must Rest in order to regain its use. If the Character has the Skill Magical Tradition <Sorcery>, they instead regain the ability to cast one(1) of their expended Cantrips as though they had Rested, in place of this Cantrip's normal effects.
Incantation: None

Title: Withering Fire
Name: Withering Fire
Effect: This Cantrip grants the Caster five(5) charges of this effect. The Caster may expend one charge to deliver, by packet, two(2) points of Magic Body. As a Cantrip, this effect can be used once, afterwards the Character must Rest in order to regain its use.
Incantation: None
